priority_policy.method: Mean of within-region midrank percentiles of choice count and distinct exam count. A>=.75, B>=.50, C>=.25, D otherwise. Ties remain tied. Zero count excluded.

modes.shortest: A; if no A due to tied sparse data, highest regional percentile group
modes.safe: A+B+C plus the highest-frequency representative(s) of each entity type, and all observed seas/straits
